project.name: Booth
project.tagline: The director is listening: real-time AI direction for voiceover takes

scenes.vo: Forty five minutes. That is what a voiceover creator loses scrubbing raw takes, every single video. Read the line, flub the number, hunt for it later.

scenes.tabTitle: Booth — live proof, no mic needed
scenes.pill: Real judge pipeline · live on screen
scenes.vo: This is Booth. A deliberately bad take runs through the real judge pipeline: transcribed by AssemblyAI, aligned to the script, and two misreads are caught on screen.

scenes.title: booth — live session — agents.assemblyai.com — zsh
scenes.pill: Live Voice Agent API · real session
scenes.vo: Now live, on AssemblyAI's Voice Agent API. The director hears the read, cuts the flub, and calls the retake by line number. Every cut is a tool call the agent made.

scenes.pill: Wrap the session · print the master
scenes.cardStat: Best read per line · spliced in browser
scenes.vo: Set your script, read it out loud, and wrap. Booth prints the master: the best read of every line, spliced from word level timestamps, right in your browser.
Booth is live now. The demo voice is synthesized. Bring yours. The director is listening.

outro.vo: Booth is live now. The demo voice is synthesized. Bring yours. The director is listening.
